rules: nil UUID is rejected

Url.format: absolute HTTPS URL without userinfo or fragment

Instant.format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ; valid UTC date; leap second value 60 rejected

Base64.format: canonical padded RFC 4648 base64; strict decode/re-encode comparison

rules: If both source times are known, updated_at >= created_at. Revision fixes every value in this object and its complete content.
Author IDs unique; primary_source_author_id, when provided on ToRecord, must name an entry in source_authors.
stream is required. Initial: cursor optional. Changes: cursor required. Duplicate/unknown query keys rejected.

Initial nonfinal: next_cursor nonnull, checkpoint null. Initial final: next null, checkpoint nonnull. Changes: checkpoint always nonnull; next nonnull only while draining the fixed current poll high-water mark.

Decoded content length <=32768. Offset + decoded length <= content_bytes. Nonfinal next_offset equals offset + decoded length and is strictly larger than offset. Final next_offset=null and offset+decoded length=content_bytes. Repeated request returns identical bytes for the same revision/offset.

Selection categories: category_ids nonempty; all_public: category_ids empty. Include/exclude lists unique and disjoint. Exclusion wins over category selection; include is not authority to publish private/deleted/draft content. Actual native author/taxonomy selections must be available in active catalogs. Only authorized Discourse administrators may write this policy; adapter route is read-only.

publication_lane is administrator-configured within the connection allowed lanes. Source/mapping/work routes use that lane without caller authority. destination_origin is an origin, not a path/query URL.
Native profile/capability/catalog declarations are descriptive, not authorization.

Reserves identity/URL only for an already eligible receiver-created publication intent. It does not enable policy or create publication work by caller request. Exact existing mapping returns that mapping; a mismatched external_id/URL is a conflict.

Hash describes only the native ownership receipt, excluding credentials. Receiver checks binding fields against authoritative stored records. Native adapter must actually validate the receipt under native lock; receiving this object alone is not independent proof of the native filesystem/database.

Local NativeOwnershipReceipt must bind current work generation; when proving a URL move it includes that move_id and public proof_nonce. Receiving a hash does not substitute for native receipt inspection.
Only a real native destination limit permits an excerpt. Read More URL equals authoritative source topic URL. No transport/body-page bound is a native publication limit.

source_revision nonnull for publish_revision and null for withdraw; attempt 0..3; terminal work cannot be reset for a new revision. Any lease generation exceeds all previous native generations for this mapping.
lease_generation is allocated from one durable monotonically increasing mapping fence counter. New work or explicit retry cycles never reset that counter; new claim advances it.
last_failure_code cannot be content_preservation_unavailable: that code is To V4-02/V4-29 response-only, not a From Work failure/attention condition.
mapping_id, if supplied, filters already existing authorized pending work; it cannot create work.

Verifier fetched actual canonical public URL on the configured native origin without credentials or redirects and compared the expected source/native identity and native rendered representation. Hash is the declared verifier profile's native publication fragment, not a copied source marker.

Only withdraw work accepts this branch. URL equals current owned mapping URL. Native owned object is unpublished and HTTP response is 404 or 410; 401/403, network failure, or an unrelated URL do not prove withdrawal.
Transient classification is receiver-derived from the code. Caller cannot make a permanent conflict transient.
content_preservation_unavailable is To-response-only and is rejected as Failure.code; no From failure/attention expansion.
An abort is not a successful publication. A false or unverifiable restoration leaves attention; successful restoration preserves previous native/public revision and exact identity.

Ownership canonical_url and PublishedVerification.url equal proposed new URL; native ID/source revision/content hash match the current authoritative mapping/work. Native receipt/proof profile binds stored move_id and nonce.
Abort releases new URL only if no native change was applied and ownership still proves old URL. Otherwise attention/reconciliation; do not free a URL potentially carrying this publication.

For a definitive authenticated valid typed invalid_field/HTTP422 refusal, an explicit authorized operator Retry after actual cause correction creates one fresh mutation_id linked privately to the refused intent after current source/ownership/authority/revision/CAS checks. Retain actual refusal evidence/history; do not replay the known rejected UUID or automatically retry its unchanged refused source. Uncertain outcomes reconcile first. This local recovery does not add wire fields; ordinary genuinely changed native source editions remain eligible.

Core IDs are canonical decimal strings. Initial creation requires expected_source_revision=null; every existing owned record uses its exact current source revision. Same source_revision with changed authoritative payload conflicts; an exact same edition resolves without write. Ordinary published native source editions only, never draft/autosave/revision-object/page-view activity. Unexpected local/moderator edits stop source-owned updates rather than overwrite discussion.

source_content_sha256/source_content_bytes describe the entire prepared native source article HTML after approved target-preserving preparation and before excerpt selection. The native original stays intact. full matches content_html exactly. generated_excerpt follows generated_excerpt selection, boundary/hash/link/cap rules. No old unmarked representation or earlier-record initialization is admitted.

created/resolved/updated have all protected resource/topic/revision/time fields nonnull. reconciliation_required has four identity/URL/native ownership/Core embed association reasons and protected fields null. adoption_unavailable names exact native Core embed association only, not earlier-record migration.

Metadata-only current binding/delivery view. From-Discourse body uses immutable source revision/chunk routes. To records have established source revision evidence; nullable fields of another direction/state are not earlier-record conversion privilege.

Withdraw only existing exactly owned current To binding with established nonnull source revision, exact expected revision and native ownership. Null is not absence-CAS or earlier-record initialization. Retain topic/discussion/native/resource IDs and URL tombstones; no implicit resume.
retryable and HTTP status are fixed by error code; retry_after_seconds null for permanent errors and otherwise null or 1..3600.

content_preservation_unavailable is permitted only as the HTTP422 permanent Error response to To V4-02/V4-29, with retryable=false and retry_after_seconds=null. It is not a From Failure or Work.last_failure_code.
kind must equal authoritative work.action. Publication and withdrawal preserve the same owned native object identity.

to_discourse only; exact owned current external/resource/topic binding and source revision. Reserve same-origin collision-free new source URL. Native source-public proof profile remains separately unresolved; declared fields do not establish it.

Issued nonce/current source revision/exact native identity and actual new-URL verification. Fresh unused new_source_revision differs from expected_source_revision. Retain title/authors/complete-source hash/count/native/external/resource/topic identity. For full retain delivered body. For generated_excerpt replace only owned generated Read More suffix/read_more_url, preserving exact article prefix and native raw outside its bound normalized segment.

Check projected HTML<=49152 and exact ToResolve envelope<=65536 before mutation; an infeasible longer/escaped URL returns body_too_large without prefix truncation. Native segment/current input/canonical metadata/fingerprint/fresh immutable ledger/URL history/reservations/mutation receipt commit atomically. No fabricated proof, same-revision repair or accepted-history rewrite.
Release new reservation only when no native move was applied and old URL ownership remains proven. Otherwise attention; retain both reservations until exact recovery.

Local durable native receipt, not a POST/GET body. SHA-256 over fixed field-order, 4-byte unsigned big-endian length-prefixed UTF-8 values; null encoded length 0xffffffff; integer encoded canonical decimal text. Never includes connection/lease/operator secrets.

Administrator selects only verified native capabilities. Caller capability claims remain descriptive and cannot grant scope or create work. An unavailable selected mode/native configuration stops publication rather than downgrade.
Current read_more_url equals canonical_url; exact terminal generated link follows exact prefix boundary/hash.
Eligibility and measurement are captured at initial selection_source_revision; verified canonical-only source moves retain that historical selection fact.

Receiver admission requires current selection revision for a new edition; exact current stored same-edition delivery and original replay retain their accepted selection snapshot. Portable shapes do not establish stored context.
Exact old Work/generation/source/policy/action; deployment pair both null or both present. No lease token.

Actual attention only. Context pins Work/cycle/source/action/policy, mapping revision/fence/native/baseline/preparation and current private connection scope/config/gates/selections. Check never creates lease/attempt/Work or replays native effects.
Strictly increasing scoped durable sequences; next_after equals last returned sequence, or caller after for empty. Persist item continuation before advancing cursor.

Only actual non-writing locked native observations and safe digests; null/unknown for missing facts, never fabricated absence. No ready boolean/article bodies/lease credentials/raw exceptions. Core derives eligibility against exact context and supported factual profile. Applied static candidate/partial/foreign/unsettled command/mutation/move/missing proof stays Not ready.
Path inspection and context must match current connection. Exact idempotent report replay; changed mutation content conflicts. A report never creates Work or native effects.

Immutable admitted successor snapshot: distinct Work/new cycle/pending/attempt0, same mapping/resource/topic/external/native identity. Predecessor superseded with full attention snapshot, unique successor. No fence reset. Settlement mode requires exact restored retained native/public baseline proof; missing baseline or applied static candidate never qualifies.
Strict sequence/cursor and durable continuation rules match inspections; recovery is independent of source change feed.
Targets only the exact recovery successor in path under current authority; never claim an unrelated replacement Work. Existing Claim remains unchanged.
Current native admin session/CSRF/XHR/Guardian/connection/topic authority; individual or selected bulk, independently checked. Duplicate work IDs rejected.
Current native admin only. Explicit true requires separately disclosed Settle restored baseline and retry action/proof. Duplicate inspection IDs rejected.
Current enabled/scoped stored connection only. No secret is emitted.
native_capabilities are stored descriptive native configuration, never authentication. Set via authorized administration and verified in component qualification.

to_discourse required. created=201, resolved/updated=200, reconciliation_required=409. Core IDs are decimal strings. Exact Core TopicEmbed canonical association allowed only with no prior Bridge mapping/current authority; no arbitrary claim or earlier-Bridge initialization.

Required native rendered-article evidence unavailable or actual content/function/data loss returns content_preservation_unavailable HTTP422, permanent/nonretryable/null retry_after_seconds after rollback; no new success/mutation receipt or automatic retry. Preserve accepted article/identities/history/exact pending and existing move/reservations.

For a definitive authenticated valid typed invalid_field/HTTP422 refusal, an explicit authorized operator Retry after actual cause correction creates one fresh mutation_id linked privately to the refused intent after current source/ownership/authority/revision/CAS checks. Retain actual refusal evidence/history; do not replay the known rejected UUID or automatically retry its unchanged refused source. Uncertain outcomes reconcile first. This local recovery does not add wire fields; ordinary genuinely changed native source editions remain eligible.
Records scoped to connection/origin/direction/lane.
resource_id UUID; unauthorized resources return resource_not_found, without disclosing another connection.

to_discourse direction only; exact owned binding marked withdrawn and future source delivery stopped. Does not delete/hide the forum topic or its discussion. Public privacy/deletion is forum-owned and is not promised by binding withdrawal.

Withdraw only existing exactly owned current To binding with established nonnull source revision, exact expected revision and native ownership. Null is not absence-CAS or earlier-record initialization. Retain topic/discussion/native/resource IDs and URL tombstones; no implicit resume.
from_discourse direction and current source policy required.
Path IDs UTF-8 percent encoded exactly once. Offset<=content_bytes; offset at end returns empty final chunk.
Read-only to adapter. Discourse administrator UI owns changes.
from_discourse only; unique key (connection_id,source_id); no caller-enabled policy or unilateral work.
At most 100 entries; private to owning enabled/scoped connection.
204 has no body. Claim one already existing work item; attempts increment atomically; no simultaneous live lease for a mapping.
No lease secret in status read.
Authority.work_id must equal path; renewal advances expiry but not lease_generation or attempt.
Authority matches path/current mapping/revision/policy/generation/token. Static work uses prepare/finalize for synchronized/verified; deployed acknowledgement may be recorded separately.
Dynamic synchronized branch uses action-matching SyncResult; deployed stage applies only to static work; verified stage uses action-matching Verification. A static verified receipt must use finalize.
Permanent errors -> attention. Transient errors -> retry_wait unless attempt ceiling reached.
static profile only. Bind transaction ID to exact work/generation/revision/native state; mark synchronized, never verified.
Action-matching SyncResult covers staged native publication and staged native withdrawal; must retain prior native/public result for abort.
static publish_revision or withdraw. Exact current prepared transaction, deployment receipt and action-matching public/absence verification required; success verified.
static only; verified work cannot be aborted. Records failure/attention, never successful publication.
Reserve new URL while old URL remains active. Authority mapping must equal path; native identity cannot change.
Current authorized lease and revision; nonce/ancestry/current native identity and public new-URL verification match. Atomically switch URL and retire/reserve old URL.
Only unapplied native move may release new URL. Ambiguous/partial applied native move -> attention, retain reservations.
Descriptive data only. Does not change policy, scope, or create work.
Sequential zero-based pages of <=100 entries; duplicate same page accepted only if semantically identical; total body bound applies.
Exact declared total and unique entry IDs; atomic active snapshot switch. Old snapshot remains active on any failure. Response gives first bounded page, not entire catalog.
Catalog private to owning connection; scoped origin enforced.
Reserve same-origin new source URL for exact current owned to_discourse record. No body/topic rebind.
Current source revision and move nonce, exact native ancestry and public new-URL receipt; retire old URL atomically.

Required native rendered-article evidence unavailable or actual content/function/data loss returns content_preservation_unavailable HTTP422, permanent/nonretryable/null retry_after_seconds after rollback; no new success/mutation receipt or automatic retry. Preserve accepted article/identities/history/exact pending and existing move/reservations.
No applied native move: abort. Applied/uncertain move: attention; do not free reservations.
to_discourse only; scoped URL ancestry, not another connection's URL inventory.
Probe before new extension. Unknown/missing capability means Unsupported/Waiting; no silently widened r5 peer or authority. Current stored supported profile only.
Bounded connection-scoped durable observation requests. No claim/attempt/Work creation, native command/callback/credential transfer or automatic retry.
Idempotent exact factual report only; current private context and supported profile checked. Never trust ready=true, generic attestation or report as independent public/native proof.
Durable positive exact successor discovery independent of unchanged source feed. Keep predecessor journal immutable; persist exact continuation before cursor.

Exact known successor Work only; current scope/source/policy/ownership and increasing fence. Return204 if it cannot currently be claimed; never a different Work. Same mutation/path replay follows exact receipt; changed selection conflicts. Native reread under fresh lease remains mandatory.

transport.mutation_scope: mutation_id required on every POST and receipts bound to connection+route+path identity
transport.byte_bound_note: Only To-Discourse content_html has the preserved 49152-byte HTML bound; response/body bounds do not impose a whole From-Discourse publication cap
transport.metadata_response_rule: Page adaptively below item maximum to respect byte bound. Never omit a required field or truncate a record; single oversized record fails metadata_unavailable.

bounds.url_history_retention: retain while binding/mapping exists, including withdrawn mappings; no automatic reuse
bounds.work_history_retention: retain latest state and unresolved work while mapping exists; retain settled detailed receipts for at least 365 days

work_transitions.rule: Archive full attention snapshot and atomically admit one linked pending successor with fresh cycle; never reset old Work or fence.

selection.serialization: existing semanticIdentity: sorted declared ASCII object keys, compact JSON, UTF8, no slash/Unicode/line-terminator escaping beyond JSON-required escapes; no whitespace
selection.full_projection: ToResolve with fixed valid 36-byte mutation UUID, same selected semantic ToRecord fields, content_html=entire prepared source article HTML, representation={kind:full}; omit adapter_id, adapter_version, correlation_id only
selection.fresh_resolve: Receiver requires selection_source_revision=source_revision for a new admission or new ordinary source edition. Original accepted replay and exact same-current-edition no-write delivery may retain the current stored historical selection snapshot. Portable shape validation cannot classify that context.
selection.source_authority: existing authenticated scoped native source owner computes exact full projection, complete digest and count; receiver cannot reconstruct omitted full content and must not claim independent verification
selection.receiver_checks: Portable shapes check closed types, exact prefix/hash/suffix, canonical and eligibility. Receiver new-selection admission requires current selection revision and, for source<=49152, rejects full-size claims outside exact current metadata + [source bytes, six times source bytes] JSON-string bounds. Exact same-current-edition delivery compares current stored identity and preserves original snapshot without recalculating current control overhead.
selection.stored_identity: SHA256 of semanticIdentity excluding adapter_id/adapter_version/correlation_id/expected_source_revision; defaults visibility=unlisted,lane=empty string,source_authors=empty list. Trusted current receiver input supplies context, never caller wire testimony.
selection.diagnostic_padding: cannot cause eligibility; full projection retains all selected semantic fields without coercion, loss or padding
selection.actual_delivery: exact actual serialized request must remain<=65536; HTML including owned link<=49152; no dropping semantic metadata

generated_link.boundary: content_html UTF8 bytes [0,article_content_bytes) are article prefix; remaining bytes are exactly prefix + escaped read_more_url + suffix
generated_link.article_rule: nonempty valid UTF8 article prefix, existing native sanitation obligation unchanged; reserved marker forbidden in prefix, case insensitive; prefix SHA256 exact
generated_link.meaning: article_content_sha256/count describe delivered excerpt article prefix, not complete source; source_content_sha256/count retain complete-source meaning

source_move.eligible: Current stored generated_excerpt with validated boundary/current native managed fingerprint, or unchanged full representation.
source_move.local_projection: retain exact prefix, title, authors, complete-source digest/count and IDs; replace only exact generated suffix/read_more_url and canonical_url; set expected_source_revision=prior, source_revision=fresh unused, source_updated_at=actual supplied time
source_move.native_projection: bind actual normalized generated native segment at creation; under current managed fingerprint preserve native raw outside that segment, title, owner, TOC, credits and historical footer; do not rebuild using current settings or choose arbitrary authored anchors
source_move.bounds: validate exact projected HTML and canonical ToResolve envelope before any receiver/native mutation; longer/more escaped URL that cannot fit fails body_too_large; never truncate prefix or alter hash/count
source_move.atomicity: existing verified same-source/current nonce/CAS checks remain; all native generated-link edit, current input/representation, canonical metadata, native fingerprint, fresh immutable ledger, reservations/history and mutation receipt committed in existing durable transaction
source_move.prepared: prepare remains old-authoritative; exact current baseline and boundary retained; retries must not apply link change before verified finalize
source_move.applied_uncommitted: retain both reservations and exact prepared baseline; same exact valid finalize may resume under current authority; uncertain/expired/mismatched state remains attention, no fabricated ownership
source_move.committed: exact original accepted mutation replay returns historical original tree/status/receipt under current auth/scope; read current state separately; no silently repaired accepted receipt or same-revision replacement

limitation: Typed/value-local validation does not establish receiver/native authority/locks/ownership/public proof/qualification/formal review/exact approval/freeze/release/deployment.
